methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic information units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two information sources.
mindtraced_atomic_units: FSM detects message boundaries in a byte stream
in[3] == 1 indicates the start of a message
out_bytes valid only when 'done' is asserted
If new start byte detected before 3 bytes received, restart message reception
spec_atomic_units: Module has clk, in[7:0], reset, out_bytes[23:0], done
done asserted after third byte received
combinational logic detects message boundary where in[3] == 1
Input filtering logic checks if in[3] is high
Byte storage logic uses three 8-bit registers
Concatenation logic combines three 8-bit registers into out_bytes
Done signal logic uses a counter to count received bytes
byte_count increments when message_start or byte_count < 3
FSM transitions on rising edge of clk
FSM has states IDLE, BYTE1, BYTE2, BYTE3, DONE
